title: The shoreward journey
hook: One animal can use ocean and shore.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The schematic path goes from water to a nest on shore. Female sea turtles lay eggs on land; the drawing does not show exact nesting sites, migration routes or the behavior of every turtle.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: In the illustrated sea turtle life cycle, where are eggs laid?

claims.text: One animal can use ocean and shore. In the illustrated sea turtle life cycle, where are eggs laid? The schematic path goes from water to a nest on shore. claims.text: The stage is a simplified schematic and the scenario is stipulated rather than observed.
